abstract_algebra: Abstract algebra centered on group theory, encompassing order of elements, factor groups, permutations, and isomorphism. Addresses homomorphisms, normal subgroups, and Abelian composition laws. Explores integral domains, fields of quotients, and Euler's totient function in analyzing element orders within symmetric groups.
anatomy: Anatomy covering head and neck structures: parotid gland, maxillary sinus, pharyngeal arches, and trachea; thoracic anatomy including lung lobes and heart auscultation sites; cartilage function, emissary veins, sinus pain referral, tonsillar tissue, with neuroanatomical and physiological integration.
astronomy: Astronomy encompassing solar system formation theories, planetary differentiation, and lunar maria genesis. Integrates atmospheric loss mechanisms, Venus radar surface mapping, and axial tilt-driven seasons. Covers planetary thermal evolution, orbital dynamics, blackbody radiation principles, and exploration challenges in planetary science.
